_comment: Example region-detection profile: license-plate sub-region detection on a vehicle crop. Loadable via OP_REGION_PROFILE_PATH=examples/region_profiles/license_plate.json. This is a worked example, not a built-in profile -- the app ships with region detection off (no active profile) until an operator points config at a file like this one.
_detector_model_comment: detector_model is left empty: this example runs segmenter-only (SAM 3, prompted by segmenter_text_prompt) plus the OCR text-hint re-pass, with no detector leg and no Triton call for it. No public plate-detector model ships with this project (no CC/permissively-licensed one was found at genericization time). Set detector_model to the Triton name of your own exported detector to add the detector leg back.
name: license_plate
_text_hint_require_letters_and_digits_co: Plate text mixes letters and digits; requiring both keeps lettering-only text elsewhere on the vehicle from seeding the text-hint re-pass. Off by default for other domains.
segmenter_text_prompt: license plate, registration plate, number plate
_secondary_shape_groups_comment: Optional: route crops whose class registry `group` value is in this set down a secondary detection path (see scripts/curation/worker/state.py::_is_secondary_shape). Empty here on purpose -- a private deployment's motorcycle-subtype taxonomy (sportbike/cruiser/etc.) isn't meaningful to a new user and doesn't match any group in the public class registry. Populate it with your own registry `group` values if your deployment needs the split; leave it empty to route nothing.
